title: Fixed-condition spectral blood slab transport lookup

derivedDataLicense.scope: Derived spectral-to-linear-sRGB transport lookup data in opticsLut.generated.ts; retain source attribution and changes when sharing/adapting the data.

sources.authors: Nienke Bosschaart, Gerda J. Edelman, Maurice C. G. Aalders, Ton G. van Leeuwen, Dirk J. Faber
sources.title: A literature review and novel theoretical approach on the optical properties of whole blood
sources.data: Appendix: oxygenated (>98%) compiled absorption and oxygenated Kramers-Kronig/Percus-Yevick calculated scattering and anisotropy, hematocrit 45%; wavelengths 360–830 nm.
sources.changes: Selected columns/range from corrected article XML; coefficients converted from mm^-1 to m^-1; linear interpolation to 1 nm. Compiled absorption is already flattened; the correction is not applied twice.

correction.description: Corrected negative exponential and intracellular-absorption subscripts in absorption flattening Eq. 3.

sources.title: Colour-matching functions of CIE 1931 standard colorimetric observer
sources.changes: Raw table retained; used at 1 nm to integrate modeled spectral transport, convert XYZ to linear sRGB, and normalize D65 white.

sources.title: CIE standard illuminant D65
sources.changes: Raw table retained; used as the fixed spectral illuminant for integration over 360–830 nm.

method.closure: Two opposite ordinate directions with cosine 1/sqrt(3); isotropic transport approximation using reduced scattering mu_s*(1-g).
method.boundary: Homogeneous plane-parallel slab; incident forward flux at front and no incoming reverse flux at back; no Fresnel/interface reflections in the LUT.
method.color: D65 and CIE 1931 2 degree observer, 1 nm trapezoidal integration, linear sRGB; clamp negative channels and normalize R/T pairs above unity.
method.lookup: 512 logarithmically spaced thickness entries, 0–0.05 m, 1 micrometre log scale, interpolation in transformed thickness.
method.dataChanges: Coefficients transformed to spectral reduced-scattering transport; derived RGB channels projected to nonnegative R,T and R+T<=1. This is a model-derived lookup, not measured reflectance.

limitations: Fixed oxygenated endpoint and hematocrit 45%; not patient-specific material identification.
D65 and standard observer do not represent a measured surgical light or camera.
Two-stream reduced-scattering closure is an approximation, especially for thin films, strongly absorbing wavelengths, and angular effects.
Total slab transmittance includes approximate diffuse transport; it is not sharp unscattered camera-ray transmission.
Screen-space aggregate particle thickness is not a reconstructed refracted multilayer optical path.
No spectral Monte Carlo validation, measured phantom validation, photorealism equivalence, or clinical validation has been completed.

operativeSceneAppearance.title: Operative scene surface-film optical adapter

derivedDataLicense.scope: The resampled R/T texture retains the derived spectral lookup license and all parent-source attribution. This section describes the optical adapter, not the license of all application source code.

operativeSceneAppearance.parentSources: experimentalAppearance and sources[0..2] in this document
changes: Sample one authored oxygenation slice of the existing attributed 512-thickness by 65-oxygenation spectral LUT into a 512 by 2 RGBA float texture.
Explicitly interpolate adjacent thickness nodes in the shader; compose top-lit substrate reflectance as R + T*T*s/(1-R*s) in linear RGB before scene lighting.
Scene millimetres are converted to metres for optical lookup; the default oxygenation fraction 0.75 is an authored assumption, not measured from surgical imagery.
limitations: Retains all parent spectral-model limitations, including fixed hematocrit 45%, D65/CIE observer and approximate two-stream transport.
Optical appearance only; no fluid volume transport, coagulation, measured thickness, surgical camera calibration or clinical validation is implied.

experimentalAppearance.title: Experimental spectral oxygenation and thickness response

derivedDataLicense.scope: bloodAppearanceLut.generated.ts derived data; original blood selected columns CC-BY-4.0; CIE data CC-BY-SA-4.0, as attributed in the parent sources.

source.table: Corrected Bosschaart appendix Taba, Hct 45%; compiled absorption oxy/deoxy columns 1/2; calculated mu_s oxy/deoxy columns 5/6; calculated g oxy/deoxy columns 7/8; wavelength column 0 (zero indexed).

changes: Extracted 360–830 nm oxy/deoxy whole-blood endpoint coefficients; source precision retained in CSV.
Interpolate wavelength coefficients to 1 nm, convert mm^-1 to m^-1, calculate reduced scattering mu_s*(1-g).

Linearly interpolate endpoint mu_a and reduced scattering by model oxygenation fraction, then solve each wavelength with the stated two-direction slab approximation. Do not reapply absorption flattening.
Integrate using attributed D65/CIE 1931 data; convert to linear sRGB with explicit passive gamut projection.
Store 65 oxygenation by 512 thickness entries as little-endian float32, interpolated in actual oxygenation fraction and log1p thickness.

assumptions.oxygenatedSourceEndpoint: >98%; model fraction 1 is this endpoint, not a measured exact 100% spectrum

limitations: Intermediate whole-blood endpoint absorption mixing does not recompute nonlinear intracellular absorption flattening.
Reduced-scattering interpolation is a modeling approximation, not measured intermediate-saturation scattering.
Two-stream closure, total diffuse transmission and RGB substrate composition do not reproduce full angular spectral transport.
No patient-specific identification, measured camera/light calibration, photorealism equivalence or clinical validation.
